subject: dym-ft
title: DYM.FT.------HI.P.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 198 (EVOL-36). DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism) is the subject; HI-P (high purpose) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), POL-DY (political dynamics) and TRS (transition). From PROG-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis). From EXP-INFO-B: IST-F (isolated focus). From POL-DY: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From EXB-H-OR: POL-P (political policies). From TRS: TR-INFO (trans-information).
